text:
rina: quick follow-up from the postmortem — last night's alert storm. want to pin owners for tuning, and make sure we track recurring patterns + timelines.
sam: agree. i'll own dedupe/fingerprinting work. plan: identify top noisy alerts, propose fingerprint keys, add dedupe window. ETA 48h for initial list.
ned: i'll own severity mapping + paging policies. thinking: move throttles and client-side rate-limit errors to non-paging severity unless rate > 5% for 10m. ETA 5d for rollout.
priya: i'll update runbooks and add a dashboard for page/no-action metrics + MTTR. need the final rule names to wire panels. ETA 1 week.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-217. initial oncall log attached.
sam: initial scan query i'll run: `topk(20, sum by (alertname)(increase(alerts_fired_total[90d])))` — will return the 20 most frequent alert rules in last 90 days.
rina: please include a column for % of pages with no human action. that's the biggest annoyance metric.
ned: for dedupe windows i'd suggest: 15m for flapping infra alerts, 60m for known transient deploy signals, fingerprint by `{{cluster}}:{{service}}:{{error_code}}`. also add `suppress_if_redeploy==true` label when deploy tags present.
sam: on the fingerprint note — we should avoid surface-level uniqueness like trace_id. we want to collapse duplicates, not hide distinct customer-impacting requests.
priya: runbook additions: a) how to override dedupe for investigations, b) paging schedule (primary 07:00-21:00 local PT), c) who to escalate for Dedicated vs Private infra. will add links in postmortem doc.
rina: owners + tickets please so we can track in postmortem follow-ups. also add a 30-day review to validate nothing critical was muted.
oncall-bot: reminder: add Jira links when created.
sam: created JIRA RINF-4010 (alert-fingerprint + dedupe), RINF-4011 (noisy-alerts top-20 report). linked to postmortem https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-23-alert-surge-patterns
ned: created JIRA RINF-4012 (severity mapping & paging policy), assigned to me. left checklist for Dedicated/Private coverage.
priya: created JIRA RINF-4013 (runbook + dashboard). Also stubbed grafana dashboard at https://grafana.redwood/d/alerts/alert-tuning (private).
rina: good. let's add acceptance criteria for each ticket: 1) new rules live in staging and monitored for 7 days, 2) dashboard shows pages by rule and % no-action, 3) runbook updated and linked in the ticket.
sam: noted. adding ACs to tickets now.
ned: scheduling: propose rollout in two waves. wave1 (staging + non-prod) 3d, wave2 (prod) after 7 days monitoring. any objections?
priya: no objections. will prepare runbook steps for rollback if we see suppressed incidents.
rina: also log pattern classification in the postmortem: transient vs recurring vs config-bug. sam, include that in your top-20 report so we can see repeat offenders.
sam: will add a tag per alert: transient|recurring|config. ETA 48h for the list.
oncall-bot: autoreminder scheduled: follow-up review in 30 days on 2026-04-22 09:00 PT.
rina: summary: sam -> fingerprint + noisy-alerts report; ned -> severity+paging policy; priya -> runbooks + dashboard; rina -> coordinate reviews and acceptance. update JIRA with blockers; ping here for approvals. thanks all :thumbsup:
